newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Larios confirms accepts Pernod offer.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Larios confirms accepts Pernod offer.

text.p: Spanish beverage firm Larios confirmed on Thursday it had decided to accept the buy out offer from French drinks group Pernod Ricard.

"The Larios board, which represents more than 60 percent of the company's capital, has decided today to accept the buy offer from Pernod Ricard and submit the deal to the rest of the shareholders," Larios said in a statement.
Larios and Pernod said the deal was expected to close on June 27, 1997. Integration of the two firms was likely to commence at the beginning of 1998, Larios said.
